subject: Hosted -> Dedicated: sizing validation, pre-cutover runbook & procurement steps
messages:
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@swarmai.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@swarmai.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing info and pre-cutover asks

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're close to an internal commitment to move our production traffic from Redwood hosted API to a Dedicated pool, and procurement asked me to capture the things they need before we sign. High level:

- Expected steady-state: ~3M requests/day (roughly 35–40M tokens/day).
- Peak 95p concurrency: ~420 concurrent inferences, average token length ~280 tokens.
- Latency target: p95 < 250ms for shortest completion templates (we do a lot of short-complete queries).

Could you provide the following as a checklist so we can move the PO forward?
1) Preliminary capacity recommendation (GPU type & count), with the conservative and optimized options.
2) Pre-cutover acceptance tests / what you need from us for traffic replay (traffic_profile_q3.csv attached).
3) Expected cutover week duration and blackout windows.
4) Procurement deliverables you need (SOW, invoice details, DocuSign link).

I've attached our sampled traffic profile and the standard security questionnaire for your references.

We'd like to get a MAP and a rough timeline this week if possible — procurement has a buying window in early November.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lewis
Head of Platform
SwarmAI

Attachments: traffic_profile_q3.csv (csv), security_questionnaire_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@swarmai.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing info and pre-cutover asks

Hi Sarah — thanks for the context and the files. Looping in Kim (solutions lead) and Marcus (inference infra) to get an ops-grade sizing and a mutual action plan (MAP).

Short answer up front: we can meet your latency target with a dedicated pool; there are two sensible lanes:

- Conservative (high headroom): 10 x H100 (interconnected pool), designed for sustained concurrency + short-tail latency.
- Optimized (cost-aware): 6 x H100 with aggressive prefix caching + request sharding and tuned batching.

Next steps we propose:
1) Marcus to run a quick rightsize calc from your profile and return token/sec numbers (we'll attach a one-page calc).
2) Kim to draft a 4-week MAP with milestones (SOW/PO/commissioning/rehearsal/cutover/canary).
3) We need a traffic replay export (ideally a 48–72 hour compressed sample) and the exact rate-limiting rules you use for production.

Can we schedule a 30-min ops sync tomorrow morning for the technical assumptions? I'll also prepare a MAP workbook (MAP-SwarmAI-v1.xlsx) and a preliminary SOW template.

Avery
Avery Johnson
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-SwarmAI-v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@swarmai.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing info and pre-cutover asks

Hi Sarah — following up with a concise sizing sketch and a proposed cutover cadence. Marcus and I validated the traffic_profile_q3.csv and ran initial throughput sims. Key assumptions: avg token latency cost model, 400 RPS equivalent at peak, request mix 70% short-complete (<=300 tokens), 30% long-streaming.

Preliminary sizing (first pass):
- Recommended baseline: 8 x H100 (80GB) nodes in a dedicated pool. This gives ~20–25k token/s sustainable with headroom for burst + canary.
- Cost-optimized alternative: 5 x H100 + applied KV/prefix cache and 10% request-shedding during the absolute peak windows.

Acceptance test / sanity gates (we will run these during commissioning):
- Throughput run at 1.2x expected peak for 2 hours (stress window).
- Latency SLO verification: p95 <= 250ms on short-complete template set.
- Regression checks on top-3 prompt families (we'll replay samples you provide).

Cutover timeline (recommended cadence):
- Week 0: Sign SOW / PO & schedule commissioning (DocuSign link will be provided).
- Week 1: Commission pool and run smoke tests.
- Week 2: Rehearsal run: 48–72h traffic replay into dedicated with read-only routing (no cutover).
- Week 3: Canary cutover (5–10% traffic) with close monitoring and rollback plan.
- Week 4: Full switchover and post-cutover validation.

We will provide a short runbook for each week. Marcus, note any infra caveats (network config, egress policies, KMS).

Thanks — will update the MAP workbook with these milestones and the SOW stub.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sizing_estimate-H100-vs-A100.pdf (pdf)
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@swarmai.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing info and pre-cutover asks

Thanks Kim and team — this is exactly what procurement wanted to see. A couple of quick notes from our side:

- Procurement prefers the cost-optimized lane but asked for a clear rollback strategy if we see sustained latency regressions during canary.
- We'll provide the 72h sample by end of day Friday and the PO contact details.
- Can you share the DocuSign SOW and an invoice template so purchasing can start routing approvals?

If we can lock Week 0 next Monday (signing + commissioning kickoff), procurement will aim to get the PO out the following week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Once we have the DocuSign link and the MAP workbook, I'll route to procurement.

Sarah
Sarah Lewis
Head of Platform, SwarmAI

Sarah / team — sending the action items and links below.

Action items we own this week:
- Drop-in MAP workbook (MAP-SwarmAI-v1.xlsx) to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SwarmAI-cutover-materials
- DocuSign SOW prepared (SOW stub + T&Cs) and ready for signature: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/SwarmAI-SOW-SWM-2026-112
- Commissioning checklist & smoke tests (Marcus) attached to the Drive.

Procurement ask: please route the PO contact and billing info to me so I can populate the invoice template.

Cutover guardrails summary (will be in the runbook):
- Canary: 5% traffic for 4 hours, monitor p95 latency, error rate, and token throughput; automatic rollback if p95 > 300ms for > 10m or error rate > 1.5x baseline.
- Rehearsal: 72h replay with read-only routing — no state mutation.
- Fallback: immediate reroute to hosted API via policy, and manual drain of the dedicated pool.

Thanks — we'll be standing by for the sample. Meeting invite now.

Avery
Avery Johnson
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
